name: storeship
description: Ship an Expo / React Native iOS app to the App Store from your Mac, built for an agent to drive: one JSON envelope, stable error codes, `state` says what to run next. Archive, export, upload, metadata, media, review submission, offer codes. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp src/sim/sim-hid.swift dist/sim/ && cp src/reel/*.swift dist/reel/ && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && node src/cli.ts docs --check docs/commands.md && node src/cli.ts docs --lang zh --check docs/zh/commands.md && node src/cli.ts skill sync --check && node src/cli.ts skill check
scripts.gen: node src/cli.ts docs > docs/commands.md && node src/cli.ts docs --lang zh > docs/zh/commands.md && node src/cli.ts skill sync

author: Ken
